001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.currentStatus.CurrentBatteryV2Response;
007
008/**
009 * Battery snapshot written when charging stops, on both the Mobi and the t:slim X2, whether the
010 * pump was taken off the charger or charging finished at 100%. Every
011 * {@link CurrentBatteryV2Response} chargingStatus 1 to 0 transition seen in the maintainer's and a
012 * tester's Mobi captures (9 of 9) has one within seconds, and every record matches such a
013 * transition. On the t:slim X2 it usually follows a {@link UsbDisconnectedHistoryLog}.
014 *
015 * The class name is provisional: opcode 35 is not in Tandem's cloud event schema or the Mobi
016 * app's history log list. {@link ChargingStartedHistoryLog} has the same layout. Fields not named
017 * here have not been identified and are exposed raw.
018 *
019 * @see CurrentBatteryV2Response
020 */
021@HistoryLogProps(
022    opCode = 35,
023    displayName = "Charging Stopped"
024)
025public class ChargingStoppedHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
026
027    private int currentBatteryAbc;
028    private int unknown12;
029    private int unknown14;
030    private int currentBatteryIbc;
031    private int unknown18;
032    private int lipoMv;
033    private int unknown22;
034    private int unknown24;
035
036    public ChargingStoppedHistoryLog() {}
037    public ChargingStoppedHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int currentBatteryAbc, int unknown12, int unknown14, int currentBatteryIbc, int unknown18, int lipoMv, int unknown22, int unknown24) {
038        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
039        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, currentBatteryAbc, unknown12, unknown14, currentBatteryIbc, unknown18, lipoMv, unknown22, unknown24);
040        this.currentBatteryAbc = currentBatteryAbc;
041        this.unknown12 = unknown12;
042        this.unknown14 = unknown14;
043        this.currentBatteryIbc = currentBatteryIbc;
044        this.unknown18 = unknown18;
045        this.lipoMv = lipoMv;
046        this.unknown22 = unknown22;
047        this.unknown24 = unknown24;
048    }
049
050    public int typeId() {
051        return 35;
052    }
053
054    /**
055     * <table border="1">
056     * <caption>Parsed fields for ChargingStoppedHistoryLog:</caption>
057     * <tr><td><code>currentBatteryAbc</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
058     * <tr><td><code>unknown12</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 12)</code></td></tr>
059     * <tr><td><code>unknown14</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
060     * <tr><td><code>currentBatteryIbc</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 16)</code></td></tr>
061     * <tr><td><code>unknown18</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
062     * <tr><td><code>lipoMv</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 20)</code></td></tr>
063     * <tr><td><code>unknown22</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
064     * <tr><td><code>unknown24</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 24)</code></td></tr>
065     * </table>
066     */
067    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
068        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
069        this.cargo = raw;
070        parseBase(raw);
071        this.currentBatteryAbc = Bytes.readShort(raw, 10);
072        this.unknown12 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 12);
073        this.unknown14 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 14);
074        this.currentBatteryIbc = Bytes.readShort(raw, 16);
075        this.unknown18 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 18);
076        this.lipoMv = Bytes.readShort(raw, 20);
077        this.unknown22 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 22);
078        this.unknown24 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 24);
079    }
080
081    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int currentBatteryAbc, int unknown12, int unknown14, int currentBatteryIbc, int unknown18, int lipoMv, int unknown22, int unknown24) {
082        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
083            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(35, 0),
084            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
085            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
086            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(currentBatteryAbc),
087            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknown12),
088            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknown14),
089            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(currentBatteryIbc),
090            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknown18),
091            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(lipoMv),
092            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknown22),
093            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknown24)));
094    }
095
096    /**
097     * @return {@link CurrentBatteryV2Response#getCurrentBatteryAbc()} at the time of the record
098     */
099    public int getCurrentBatteryAbc() {
100        return currentBatteryAbc;
101    }
102
103    /**
104     * Equal to {@link CurrentBatteryV2Response#getUnknown1()} at the time of the record;
105     * 100 * unknown18 / unknown12 is within 1 of {@link #getCurrentBatteryAbc()} in 246 of 249
106     * records.
107     *
108     * @return raw uint16 at offset 12
109     */
110    public int getUnknown12() {
111        return unknown12;
112    }
113
114    /**
115     * unknown14 / 10 - 273.15 is within 2.5 of {@link #getUnknown24()} in 197 of 202 Mobi
116     * records, so this is probably a temperature in 0.1 K (unconfirmed). Also present on the
117     * t:slim X2 (2947-3083 there).
118     *
119     * @return raw uint16 at offset 14
120     */
121    public int getUnknown14() {
122        return unknown14;
123    }
124
125    /**
126     * @return {@link CurrentBatteryV2Response#getCurrentBatteryIbc()} at the time of the record
127     */
128    public int getCurrentBatteryIbc() {
129        return currentBatteryIbc;
130    }
131
132    /**
133     * Equal to {@link CurrentBatteryV2Response#getUnknown2()} at the time of the record.
134     *
135     * @return raw uint16 at offset 18
136     */
137    public int getUnknown18() {
138        return unknown18;
139    }
140
141    /**
142     * Equal (within 2 mV) to {@link CurrentBatteryV2Response#getUnknown3()} at the time of the
143     * record.
144     *
145     * @return battery voltage in millivolts
146     */
147    public int getLipoMv() {
148        return lipoMv;
149    }
150
151    /**
152     * 0 on the t:slim X2 and on Mobi firmware 7.9.0.2. On an older-firmware Mobi it was 0, 1 or 2.
153     *
154     * @return raw uint16 at offset 22
155     */
156    public int getUnknown22() {
157        return unknown22;
158    }
159
160    /**
161     * 0 on the t:slim X2. On the Mobi it stays within a few units of
162     * {@link #getUnknown14()} / 10 - 273.15, which suggests a second temperature reading in
163     * degrees C (unconfirmed).
164     *
165     * @return raw uint16 at offset 24
166     */
167    public int getUnknown24() {
168        return unknown24;
169    }
170}
